description: DRY-05: HTTP client create-use-close lifecycle duplicated in HtmlExtractor (L71-84), ManifestExtractor (L48-84), SingleRequest (L88-106). All use same pattern: create client, begin/ensure/close. Add HttpClientFactory.with_client(uri, timeout, &block) that handles create + ensure-close automatically.
title: DRY: Extract HTTP client lifecycle helper
